title: Fix lost-update race in Inventory.reserve
prompt: Inventory.reserve(n) in inventory.mjs has a deterministic lost-update race: it reads this.stock, awaits, then writes back a stale value, so two concurrent reserve() calls both read the same starting stock and one decrement is lost. Fix reserve() so concurrent calls are applied sequentially (e.g. an internal promise queue, or don't interleave the read-modify-write) while keeping the same public API: reserve(n) resolves to the remaining stock and rejects with an Error when stock is insufficient. Verify with `node check.mjs` (exit code 0 means done).
